When an affix having an indicatory स् follows then that which precedes it is called पद।

Terms: पद-न् , क्य

The affix कन् comes in the sense of 'who goes to work thus' after the words शीत and उष्ण।

Terms: कन्

After शिति , a word retains in a बहुव्रीहि समास its original accent when it is always of not more than two syllables with the exception of भसद्.।

Terms: समास end acute-2nd-term
